paragraphs.text:
You press yourself into the shadows, listening hard and keeping 
your breaths shallow. Somewhere nearby, leaves rustle. Is that a 
buzzing in the distance?

Roll 1D10: if the result is even, go to 518: if the result is odd, go 
to 515.
